nodes.name: Distribution Checklist
nodes.summary: Step-by-step launch checklist covering six distribution channels: Show HN, npm TypeScript SDK, VS Code Marketplace, HuggingFace Space, GitHub Copilot Extension, and PyPI. Includes shell commands for each channel and a post-launch monitoring checklist for tracking downloads, installs, and community engagement.

nodes.name: GitHub Copilot Extension Plan
nodes.summary: Three-day implementation plan for a GitHub Copilot Extension that gives Copilot Chat persistent memory via HipCortex MCP. Covers architecture (Copilot Chat -> Extension API -> HipCortex MCP Server), five slash commands (/remember, /recall, /forget, /context, /health), key file layout, and a three-tier monetization model (Free / Pro $9/mo / Team $29/mo).

nodes.name: Reddit r/LocalLLAMA Launch Post
nodes.summary: Drafted launch post for r/LocalLLAMA (plus r/MachineLearning and LinkedIn variants) highlighting HipCortex v0.2 features: 0.6ms write latency, temporal decay, causal world model, Merkle-chained audit log, and one-command MCP install for Cursor/Claude Code. Includes demand-threshold signal table to gate further investment decisions (Fly.io SaaS, SOC 2, enterprise outreach) based on GitHub stars, PyPI installs, and issue volume.

nodes.name: Show HN Submission
nodes.summary: Prepared Hacker News Show HN post for HipCortex, leading with the metacognitive intelligence layer (Self-Model, World-Model Enhanced, Coherence Checker) and the proactive agent harness achieving ~93% context reduction. Includes a submission checklist (binary paths, live endpoints, timing), pre-written responses to anticipated HN comments (MemGPT comparison, benchmark fairness, why Rust, production readiness), and cross-post coordination with r/LocalLLAMA.
